name: 04 - Dispute Letter Generation
description: Generates FCRA-compliant dispute letters per bureau via Claude, lints each draft for banned phrases and statute citations, saves as pending_review or flags for manual rewrite.

parameters.query:
SELECT ni.item_id, ni.case_id, ni.bureau, ni.creditor,
       ni.account_number_masked, ni.item_type, ni.dispute_basis,
       ni.fcra_sections, ni.rationale, c.first_name, c.last_name,
       c.street, c.city, c.state, c.zip, c.ssn_last4,
       COALESCE(c.current_round, 1) AS round
FROM negative_items ni
JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = ni.case_id
WHERE ni.case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}' AND ni.analysis_status = 'disputable';

parameters.jsCode:
const inp = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { ...inp, letter_body_safe: (inp.letter_body || '').replace(/'/g, "''"), item_ids_json: JSON.stringify(inp.item_ids || []), lint_violations_json: JSON.stringify(inp.lint_violations || []) } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO dispute_letters (case_id, bureau, round, letter_body, item_ids, letter_status, created_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.case_id }}', '{{ $json.bureau }}', {{ $json.round }},
  '{{ $json.letter_body_safe }}', '{{ $json.item_ids_json }}'::jsonb, 'pending_review', now())
RETURNING letter_id;

INSERT INTO dispute_letters (case_id, bureau, round, letter_body, item_ids, letter_status, lint_violations, created_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.case_id }}', '{{ $json.bureau }}', {{ $json.round }},
  '{{ $json.letter_body_safe }}', '{{ $json.item_ids_json }}'::jsonb, 'needs_rewrite',
  '{{ $json.lint_violations_json }}'::jsonb, now())
RETURNING letter_id;
